claim: "The Palestine Laboratory: How Israel Exports the Technology of Occupation Around the World" is a 2023 book by Australian journalist Antony Loewenstein (Verso). It won the 2023 Walkley Book Award — the top book prize of Australia's national journalism awards. Its thesis: Israeli military and surveillance firms field-test weapons, drones, spyware, and facial-recognition systems in the occupied West Bank and Gaza, then market them abroad as combat-proven and export them to governments, border agencies, and police. One documented case fits the pattern. Elbit Systems, Israel's largest weapons manufacturer, advertises its products as "battle-proven" in Gaza and the West Bank; through its subsidiary Elbit America it builds the AI-powered autonomous surveillance towers along the US–Mexico border for U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP), and in July 2026 was awarded a further $370 million in CBP contracts.

notes: Group A of the Dax3kEbONS- decomposition. Verified facts only: (1) the book exists — Verso 2023, subtitle verbatim from publisher; (2) it won the 2023 Walkley Book Award, announced Nov 23, 2023, judges' citation verbatim from Books+Publishing (beat Ghosts of the Orphanage and Crossing the Line on the shortlist); (3) Elbit Systems is Israel's largest weapons manufacturer, markets products as 'battle-proven' in Gaza/West Bank, and Elbit America holds the CBP surveillance-tower contract (307 towers program) — Truthout; (4) the July 2026 $370M CBP award — Calcalist/CTech, Elbit America statement verbatim. The reel's broader framing — 'the Palestine Laboratory is now at a local police department near you,' 'whatever they're willing to do to Palestinians, we're willing to do to you,' and the tie to the housing/climate/student-loan/AI-displacement 'plan' — is political interpretation (Group B), not asserted here. The scripted cold-open ('nice little database,' 'optimistic terrorists,' being videotaped) is a dramatization (Group B, satire), not a factual claim. NSO Group/Pegasus, another export in the same pattern, is documented separately at 2026-nso-comeback-001. Elbit '85% of Israel army land equipment' figure (AFSC Investigate) intentionally softened to the uncontested 'largest weapons manufacturer.' Do not adopt Truthout's 'apartheid regime' framing in our voice — only the factual clauses quoted.
